name: my-opencli
description: Personal OpenCLI plugins (chatgpt-agent, douyin-ext, gemini-agent, jimeng-agent, utils)

utils.description: Host-Chrome utilities, including background/foreground scrape with my-mcp content cleaning

chatgpt-agent.description: Protocol-stream ChatGPT agent: HTTP SSE + WS capture, sequential upload, file/image export

douyin-ext.description: Douyin video downloads via in-page read-only metadata fetch and local streaming MP4 download

gemini-agent.description: Protocol-stream Gemini agent: StreamGenerate capture, sequential attachment upload, generated-image download

jimeng-agent.description: Jimeng Agent video drafts with Canvas preparation, exact resource correlation, status search and official download
